videos.script: Frameworks say what a security programme should achieve. A small shop with one IT person needs something blunter. What do I do on Monday? {{monday}} The CIS Controls answer that. Eighteen controls, in priority order, split into groups by how big and how exposed an organisation is. {{eighteen}} Beside them sit the CIS Benchmarks: detailed configuration checklists for one product at a time. {{benchmarks}} In the lab, ana checks four lines of a checklist for the shop's SSH server. The configuration file looks harmless. The settings the server would actually use fail all four. {{lab}} A small fix later, all four pass. And you will see what a checklist can never tell you, however long it is. {{limits}}
